authorization.grantedBy: owner (netbka), delegated to the owner's main session
authorization.text: On 2026-10-10 the owner delegated the D-040 decision for netbka/Dyk#457 ('D-40 Review the product and guidelines. Make own decision') and asked for the work to be released ('Release to prod I will check there'). The delegated D-040 decision approved the #476 composition with seven required corrections and allowed the #457 runtime wiring once the corrected Storybook passes independent visual review and is merged. This campaign applies the corrections, then wires the runtime. Two tasks, one worker at a time; PRs only, never merge or deploy; no production access. No limits (owner removed them); provider subscription limits and the no-progress guard are the stops. Provider order Claude, Codex, Cursor.

constraints: Campaign for netbka/Dyk#457 only. Do not start or change #469, #475, #477, #433, #430, #181, #399, #426, #157 or other agents' branches.

No production access, deployment, GitHub Actions, paid services, or Playwright and other browser-driven tests (Dyk owner rule). Local disposable SQL is allowed only through the repository runners (npm run test:sql / npm run journeys with a selected scope) when a task changes a route or persistence; never the production database.
Never read .env contents, credentials, private conversations or real user data; fixtures are synthetic.
A Storybook build or passing tests is not visual acceptance. Do not remove worktrees, delete branches or link another checkout's node_modules.
Do not add any new blocking gate, lock, required approval or check that depends on owner-provisioned keys, credentials or setup (owner, 2026-10-10).

tasks.title: Apply the D-040 corrections to the #457 Storybook stage
tasks.goal: Start from PR netbka/Dyk#476 (branch campaign/dyk-457-storybook-stage/STORYBOOK-457, head bbd9be06): merge that branch into your task branch first, so the new PR supersedes #476. Then apply all seven required corrections from the delegated D-040 decision (gh pr view 476 --repo netbka/Dyk --comments, comment 6101849722): (1) express the overview connection rows with the shared ConnectionCard contract (app/src/connection-card-ui.js, docs/UI_COMPONENTS.md), extending it rather than forking, with no action on an outage and Connect/Reconnect primary; (2) give the states that need action (needs reconnecting, disconnected) a tone distinct from temporarily unavailable, matching production Profile; (3) use production wording ('Try again' / 'ניסיון נוסף', 'Set up again') and a natural RU title; (4) render the Sources stories with the production Chats renderer and its per-row sourceProblem() notice, with no duplicate list-level entry; (5) make a My people row lead to selecting or inspecting that person's chats; (6) add the Telegram-only one-source state; (7) give every interactive control at least a 44x44 px hit area at 320 px. Apply the listed nice-to-haves if they are cheap. RU/EN/HE at 320 and 390 with Hebrew/mixed names, synthetic fixtures.
constraints: Change files under storybook/ only, plus app/src/connection-card-ui.js and its existing tests if the shared ConnectionCard contract must be extended (keep production behavior identical for current Profile consumers).
Faithfully apply the decision; do not introduce a new visual language. Keep exactly four dock destinations.
acceptance: Each of the seven corrections is addressed, with the story ids that show it; npm run storybook:build and the storybook node tests pass, with exact commands; any ConnectionCard change keeps its existing tests green.
The PR body says it supersedes #476 and lists, for the independent visual review, the story ids, locales and widths to check; it states the visual verdict is pending.

tasks.title: Wire the approved Master overview connections into the product
tasks.goal: Implement netbka/Dyk#457 in the production app exactly as the merged, corrected Storybook stage (FIX-476) shows it: the completed Master overview with Connections rows (shared ConnectionCard, real WhatsApp/Telegram status, one literal action), My people rows that lead to that person's chats, a low-emphasis 'Set up again', and the contextual source entry in Chats through the existing per-row notice. Reuse existing status owners (WhatsApp/Telegram connection state, Profile's ConnectionCard consumers); add no new provider calls, schema or capability. Keep the Storybook Production stories in sync with the renderer in the same change (Storybook is not post-hoc documentation). RU/EN/HE, true Hebrew RTL, 320/390 widths, 44px hit areas.
constraints: Faithful implementation of the approved Storybook result only (D-040): no new visible behavior beyond it. If something cannot be implemented as shown, stop and report blocked with the exact difference.
Truthful states (T2): sign-in-only Telegram is never shown as connected, a pending unlink never offers Connect, an outage is never shown as disconnected.
acceptance: Focused node/UI contracts for the changed renderers and routes pass (npm run check -- <feature> or --files=..., exact commands); if a route or persistence read changed, the selected HTTP journey or SQL contract passes on disposable local SQL.

Production Storybook stories for the changed surfaces render the runtime renderer and the storybook build passes; the PR lists the story ids for independent visual review and states the visual verdict is pending.
git diff main --stat shows no migrations, provider adapters or deploy changes.
